shots.text: Right now, a customer is messaging your WhatsApp to buy from you. But you are asleep, busy, or away from your phone.
By the time you reply, they have already bought from your competitor. In business, delayed replies are lost money.
This is BizBot. An intelligent chat system that turns your WhatsApp into a twenty-four-seven sales machine.
No more typing long paragraphs. BizBot answers in zero point two seconds with instant interactive buttons that let buyers browse, call, and order on autopilot.
Starting at just two hundred rupees a month. Make your chats work alone at bizbot dot zernox dot net.
